In S the deficit (0.38-0.44) holds at all velocities where HCN is detected (to ~260 km/s). The Bridge wing rise is 2.9 sigma and is not claimed as significant. Contamination and aperture-shift limits are quantified or declared unquantified. RADEX interpretation (N: two thick, thermalised lines; S: needs X<=1 or Tex(HCN)<Tex(HCO+)) is carried to physical quantities with the degeneracies stated. I did not re-run the scripts; I checked the outputs and the report wording.
